# Kautusang Bayan Blg. 07, Serye ng Taong 2021

**Kapasiyahan Blg. 090 — Isang Kapasiyahang may Kaakit na Kautusang Bayan na Nagsusugo sa Kautusang Bayan Bilang 06-SKBT ng Taong 2018 na Nagtatakda ng Paraan ng Paglalabas ng Pondong Pangkomunikasyon ng mga Halal na Opisyal, mga Pinuno ng Bawat Tanggapan, mga Designated Officer-In-Charge at Designated Capacity ng Bayan ng Pitogo, Quezon**

_(Amending KB 06-SKBT of 2018 on Communication Fund Disbursement for Elected Officials, Office Heads, and Designated Officers-in-Charge)_

## Summary

Enacted on March 29, 2021, this ordinance amends [[MO-06-S2018|Kautusang Bayan Blg. 06-SKBT of 2018]], which prescribes the procedures for disbursement of communication funds for elected officials, office heads, designated officers-in-charge, and designated capacity personnel of the Municipality of [[Pitogo, Quezon]]. Absent: [[Ariel A. Enriquez]] (Sick Leave), [[Fidel M. Malapit]] (On Leave).

> **Note:** The file `img20231013_10472595.pdf` in the same folder appears to be a duplicate/related document of this ordinance (Kapasiyahan Blg. 090).

## Key Provisions

1. **Amendment to KB 06-SKBT of 2018**: Modifies the existing rules on communication fund disbursement to update allowable amounts or procedures.

2. **Coverage**: Applies to elected officials, heads of offices, designated officers-in-charge, and designated capacity personnel of the municipality.

3. **Disbursement Procedures**: Prescribes updated procedures for the release and liquidation of communication funds.
